---
title: "Part-day"
subtitle: "Two halves, with a facilitator"
---
This format fills a slot of two to three hours, with nothing to install, nothing sent to a class chart and nothing preregistered. The session works on a field experiment, in which emails that differed only in the name that signed them were sent to public housing authorities in the United States, and on a claim of the original authors (OAs) that five analysts reanalysed for the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026). You leave with an estimand statement of your own, a reproduced value, and the place of the analysis that you would defend among the 64 specifications on the curve of the claim.

## How you work

The session runs on its deck, whose slides run R inside your browser, with the data already in place. The browser lab holds the same tasks and is the fallback if the deck does not load.

[Open the deck](slides.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab](../../lab.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
